content: SLA/escalation for compliance remediation in GRC platforms: severity-tiered due-date windows (critical 15-30d, high 30-60d, medium 60-90d, low next-cycle), automatic escalation notifications to task owner + owner's manager when overdue, escalation frequency/recipients configurable, leadership dashboard surfaces aging items, and every escalation/breach event is logged to an immutable audit trail (who was notified, when, why breached, compensating controls) because auditors expect documented justification for SLA misses, not silent breach. SLA windows must trace to a written policy, not just app config.
